bio: Antonino was born on 15 May 1658, son of Gerolimo Cicco and Berardina Mastroianni ([R4-S1]). He married Anna Maletta on 5 October 1681 ([R4-S2]) and was buried on 20 April 1710 ([R4-S3]).
